thread:
Maria: Heads up — canary for SDK telemetry sampling now live on dev. We changed the sampling header and the Python client will send `X-RDWD-SAMPLE` by default. Need eyes re: console mapping and quota math.

Sam: Saw it. Console shows spikes in un-sampled traffic and quota calc is off for a couple tenants. Did we wire the new header to the ingest path?

Olivia: Not yet. I only wired the policy service to accept the new header. Console ingestion still expects `X-RDWD-SAMPLING`.

Maria: Oof. Can we add a quick translation layer in ingest as a hotfix? Python patch is ready to ship today but TS/Go releases will lag a bit.

Sam: +1 for translation layer. Also propose temporary sampling default = 10% for the canary so math is less noisy. We should emit a metric `telemetry.header.mapped` when translation happens.

Olivia: I'll push an ingest shim. Quick config I plan to apply (staging):
```yaml
headers:
  accept:
    - X-RDWD-SAMPLE
    - X-RDWD-SAMPLING
  map:
    X-RDWD-SAMPLE: X-RDWD-SAMPLING
sampling_default: 0.10
```

Jia: UX note — the console quota burn chart uses sampled tokens for estimator. If sampling semantics change, the displayed burn will be off. We should annotate charts with the sampling rate and add an optional raw-token overlay.

Maria: Agree. Also add a rollout tag to the canary so we can filter runs (e.g., `canary:sdk-sampling-v2`). Makes it easier to correlate anomalies.

infra-bot: deploy started: ingest-shim -> staging (build 2026.03.23.7). ETA ~3m.

Sam: After shim is up in staging, we'll flip the Python canary default to 15% and tail the `telemetry.header.mapped` metric. I'll draft a short devex blurb for release notes. :memo: :shipit:

Olivia: Shim is live in staging. Console mapping shows `X-RDWD-SAMPLE` traffic mapped to `X-RDWD-SAMPLING`. Quota calc back in line for tested tenants.

Maria: Nice. Schedule a 30m post-rollout check and set an alert: if quota estimator deviates >5% for any tenant, roll back sampling change and file incident. Ping #incidents if triggered.

Sam: Will do. Thanks all.

Olivia: Also filing a tiny follow-up: update docs & SDK changelogs so integrators know both headers are accepted for the next 48h, then we'll phase the old one out.

Maria: Perfect. Closing after post-check. :white_check_mark:
